    Finite ideal lattices and primitive-projective Hom chains #

    For a complete primitive-projective presentation, endpoint-stable subspaces of a concrete corner Hom space embed into the ambient two-sided ideal lattice. The remainder of the Jans pencil argument will use this finiteness together with the residue characters of the local endpoint endomorphism rings.
